approvedWording.heading: Start with the Velori configurator
approvedWording.soleParagraph: Start with Velori’s design system, configurator and product assets. Explore and refine your Review and Cart screens in Claude Design, then compare your result with the supplied completed example.

editorialDecision: The section now tells the Velori exercise reader what to start with, what to create in Claude Design and when to compare the completed example. The surrounding source-ownership and checkpoint instructions remain consistent. The paragraph adds no general restriction on using existing screens in normal product work.
